Package Fitness.InstructorP.DiscussionFromP

Class Comment

java.lang.Object
Fitness.InstructorP.DiscussionFromP.Post
Fitness.InstructorP.DiscussionFromP.Comment
public class Comment extends Post
The Comment class represents a comment on a post in the system. It extends the Post class and adds additional functionality for replies to a post, along with methods for comparing comment dates.

Each comment is associated with a post, and can have replies, which are stored in a list of Comment objects. The comment also includes metadata such as the comment's author, content, time, date, and day.

The comment's date is automatically set to the date of the post to which it belongs, and the reply list allows for tracking replies to the comment.

Example usage: 
 Comment comment = new Comment(author, content, time, post);
 comment.setReply(true);
Author:
Omar Abumazen
